strings.exam.theory.validity: A pass in the theory test is valid for 2 years from the date it is obtained (para. 23 of the Examination Rules, 2026 edition). After three failed attempts at the practical test, the theory result is cancelled ⟦1⟧.
strings.exam.theory.notes.0: The test has 40 questions. Each has several answer options and only one is correct ⟦2⟧.
strings.exam.theory.notes.1: You have 40 minutes for all the questions. The computer keeps the time, and the test ends automatically when time runs out ⟦3⟧.
strings.exam.theory.notes.2: To pass, you must answer at least 32 questions correctly, that is, you can make no more than 8 mistakes ⟦4⟧.
strings.exam.theory.notes.3: You choose the language of the test: Kazakh, Russian or English ⟦5⟧. Foreigners who do not speak Kazakh or Russian may take the theory test with a qualified interpreter ⟦6⟧.
strings.exam.theory.notes.4: You can answer in any order: you can skip a difficult question and come back to it later ⟦7⟧.
strings.exam.theory.notes.5: Each answer is confirmed by pressing the same key again. This protects against pressing a key by accident ⟦8⟧.
strings.exam.theory.notes.6: The result and the correct answers are shown only after you have answered all the questions or when time runs out ⟦9⟧.
strings.exam.theory.notes.7: Biometric identification takes place before the test, and your identity is checked during and after the test as well. After identification, you have 3 minutes to take your seat ⟦10⟧.
strings.exam.theory.notes.8: If you are ill on the day of the test, tell the examiner: the test can be rescheduled ⟦11⟧.
strings.exam.theory.notes.9: Phones, headphones, cheat sheets, sharing materials and leaving the room are prohibited. For a violation, the test is stopped, you are marked “fail”, and you cannot retake it for at least 3 months ⟦12⟧.
strings.exam.theory.notes.10: The theory test comes first, then the practical test. If you have not passed the theory test, you will not be admitted to the practical test ⟦13⟧.
strings.exam.practical.where: At the automated test ground of the State Corporation “Government for Citizens” (specialised PSC), in an exam car fitted with sensors and video cameras ⟦14⟧. The exercises are performed one after another according to the diagram of the particular test ground.
strings.exam.practical.scoring: Scoring is done by an automatic system, with no staff involved, and the result cannot be changed ⟦15⟧. Mistakes earn penalty points, which are added up. Under the test ground methodology, 99 points or fewer is a “pass”; if you reach 100 points, the test is stopped immediately and you are marked “fail”.
strings.exam.practical.notes.0: The system monitors wheels touching lines, the stopping position, gear selection, speed, direction indicators and hazard warning lights, the seat belt, and the time taken to complete the exercises ⟦16⟧.
strings.exam.practical.notes.1: For category B, the Rules describe 12 exercise zones: Start, Stopping and moving off uphill, Crossing a pedestrian crossing, 90-degree turns, Snake, U-turn and parking, Parallel reverse parking, Crossing a controlled intersection, Crossing an uncontrolled level crossing, Acceleration lane, Emergency stop, Finish ⟦17⟧. The order is set by the diagram of the test ground, so look at the diagram of your own specialised PSC in advance.
strings.exam.practical.notes.2: Errors that mean an immediate fail under the test ground methodology: not moving off within 30 seconds after the “Start” command, and driving through an intersection or over the “Stop” line on a stop signal of the traffic lights.
strings.exam.practical.notes.3: Speed on the test ground is limited by signs (usually 20 km/h), and exceeding it is penalised.
strings.exam.practical.notes.4: The car has voice prompts in Kazakh and Russian, everything is recorded by 360-degree cameras, and the recordings are kept for at least 12 months ⟦18⟧.
strings.exam.practical.notes.5: You take the test in the State Corporation’s car, not your own. Ask your driving school for the parking reference points for the model used at your specialised PSC.
strings.exam.practical.notes.6: If you are sure that points were awarded by mistake: request the video recording from the test ground and from the car, and submit an appeal through e-Otinish. The State Corporation has stated that if a technical fault is confirmed, the result is cancelled and the test is rescheduled (media reports, September 2026).
strings.exam.retakes.0: After the first fail, the retake (of both the theory test and the practical test) is scheduled for the next working day ⟦19⟧.
strings.exam.retakes.1: After two failed attempts at the theory test, each following attempt is allowed no earlier than one month later ⟦20⟧.
strings.exam.retakes.2: After two failed attempts at the practical test, the next one is allowed no earlier than one month later ⟦21⟧.
strings.exam.retakes.3: After three failed attempts at the practical test, the theory result is cancelled, the attempt counter is reset, and you are admitted to the theory test no earlier than two months later ⟦22⟧.
strings.exam.retakes.4: A violation during the theory test (prompting, phone, leaving the room) means “fail” and a retake no earlier than 3 months later ⟦23⟧.
strings.exam.retakes.5: If biometric identification did not confirm your identity when you applied, you are not admitted to the tests for 6 months ⟦24⟧.
strings.exam.retakes.6: You do not have to pay the state fee for a retake: it is charged only for issuing the licence (clarification from the State Corporation, May 2026).
strings.exam.retakes.7: The Examination Rules allow a retake on the next working day, but because of queues in some cities, free slots come much later. Book in advance.
strings.exam.retakes.8: Unlimited paid retakes at 10-day intervals have so far only been approved by the government (April 2026). They are not in the text of the Examination Rules (July 2026 edition), so the procedure described above applies.
strings.exam.steps.0.p: You can get a category B licence from the age of 18. You are admitted to the tests once you reach the age set by article 74 of the Road Traffic Act ⟦25⟧.
strings.exam.steps.1.p: You need a medical certificate of fitness to drive, Form No. 073/u ⟦26⟧. It is issued at a polyclinic. As a rule, the medical examination data are transferred electronically, and you do not need to bring a paper certificate to the specialised PSC.
strings.exam.steps.2.p: To be admitted to the tests, you need a certificate of completion of a course at a driver training organisation ⟦27⟧. You cannot learn to drive on the roads by yourself: learner driving on roads is allowed only with an instructor and after mastering the basic skills on a closed area (paras 146 and 147 of the Rules). The exceptions mentioned in the media are graduates of colleges and universities with a diploma in automotive and tractor engineering, and military personnel who trained in the army ⟦28⟧. If you belong to one of these groups, check the list of documents at the specialised PSC.
strings.exam.steps.3.p: Submit your application through the eGov portal, the eGov Mobile app or a PSC, or through an operator. Biometric identification is carried out when you apply ⟦29⟧. You choose the place, date and time of the test yourself from the available slots, at least one working day in advance ⟦30⟧.
strings.exam.steps.4.p: 40 questions, 40 minutes, at least 32 correct answers ⟦31⟧. Bring your ID and do not take your phone into the room. A pass is valid for 2 years ⟦32⟧.
strings.exam.steps.5.h: 6. Pass the practical test at the test ground
strings.exam.steps.5.p: The test takes place at the specialised PSC’s automated test ground, and the system scores it in penalty points ⟦33⟧. Under the test ground methodology, 100 penalty points means “fail”. You can take the practical test only after passing the theory test ⟦34⟧.
strings.exam.steps.6.h: 7. Pay the state fee and receive your licence
strings.exam.steps.6.p: The state fee for issuing a driving licence is 1.25 MCI (monthly calculation index; art. 667 of the Tax Code). In 2026 the MCI is 4 325 tenge, so the fee is about 5 406 tenge. It is paid online when you apply, and the tests are not paid for separately. The finished licence is issued in person at the centre you chose and is valid for 10 years ⟦35⟧.
strings.exam.changes2026.0.h: Transmission type is no longer shown on the licence
strings.exam.changes2026.0.date: Ministry of Internal Affairs Order No. 342 of 12.05.2026; according to lada.kz and noks.kz, from 25.05.2026; according to inbusiness.kz and el.kz, from 12.07.2026
strings.exam.changes2026.0.p: Information on the transmission type is not entered in the “Special notes” box of new licences: if you passed the test in an automatic car, you may also drive a manual one. According to media reports, for those who already have the note, it most likely stays valid until the licence is replaced; there is no official clarification on this.
strings.exam.changes2026.1.h: Theory test result is valid for 2 years
strings.exam.changes2026.1.date: 2026, Ministry of Internal Affairs Order No. 342 of 12.05.2026
strings.exam.changes2026.1.p: The State Corporation used to explain that no validity period was set for the theory result. Now para. 23 of the Examination Rules states that a pass in the theory test is valid for two years from the date it is obtained.
strings.exam.changes2026.2.h: New requirements for drivers under the law of 24.06.2026
strings.exam.changes2026.2.p: Drivers over 65 and people with disabilities must have a medical examination every two years, and without confirmation in the system their licence is suspended. Repeat offenders (dangerous manoeuvring, speeding, dangerous parking) may be sent to retake the theory test: if they do not pass within two months without a valid reason, the right to drive is terminated. If, after a crash while intoxicated, the criminal case is closed without a sentence (for example, on reconciliation of the parties), the right to drive is terminated; it can be regained no earlier than 8 years later, after a medical examination and a test on the Road Traffic Rules.
strings.exam.changes2026.3.h: Unlimited paid retakes and AI at tests
strings.exam.changes2026.3.status: announced, not yet added to the Examination Rules
strings.exam.changes2026.3.date: approved at a government meeting on 14.04.2026, no effective date given
strings.exam.changes2026.3.p: The plan: unlimited paid retakes with a break of at least 10 calendar days, monitoring of tests using artificial intelligence and computer vision, and suspension from the theory test for up to one year for attempting to cheat. The Ministry of Internal Affairs explained that one free retake every 30 days would remain, while paid retakes could be taken every 10 days. A pilot will start in Astana.
strings.exam.changes2026.4.h: Private test grounds and extended specialised PSC hours
strings.exam.changes2026.4.p: Because of queues of up to six months for tests, a Mazhilis deputy proposed accepting the practical test at driving school test grounds under uniform standards, extending specialised PSC working hours to 20:00, opening additional places for the theory test, and distributing slots only through eGov and eGov Mobile. According to the deputy, on 13.07.2026, 79 414 people were waiting for the theory test and 35 542 for the practical test.
